question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

A __detrimental __attitude can always be cured with a cordial approach.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"detrimental"** refers to something that causes harm or damage. (हानिकारक)

 
 
• **Example:** Smoking is detrimental to your health.
 
 
 
• **"Damaging"** is a synonym for detrimental and means causing harm or injury. (नुकसानदेह)
 
 
• **Example:** The damaging effects of pollution are evident in today's environment.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym for **"detrimental"** is **"damaging"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unmindful** (असावधान): Not paying attention or heedless.

 
 
• **Example:** She was unmindful of the consequences of her actions.
 
 
 
• **Social** (सामाजिक): Relating to society or its organization.
 
 
• **Example:** He is known for his social work and community service.
 
 
 
• **Cooperative** (सहकारी): Willing to work together or help others.
 
 
• **Example:** The cooperative members worked hard to achieve their goals.
